policy: Kept apart from the registered DrivAer benchmark: no borrowed Cd target, no assumed physical scale or aerodynamic accuracy.
Not training labels and not production references. CFD or training use needs geometry preparation and independently generated, converged labels.
Model files stay in the git-ignored scratch/sketchfab-cars/ folder; they are not committed or redistributed.
licence_evidence: Each GLB's asset.extras names CC-BY-4.0, the author and the source URL. That is the uploader's own metadata inside the file; no separate licence record (page capture or download receipt) is stored. CC-BY-4.0 requires attribution in anything that redistributes or shows the model.

cars.orientation: longest axis is glTF z, height is y (y up); front direction not in metadata
cars.scale_reading: 4.70 file units long, consistent with a metre-scale model of a car about 4.7 m long; the comparison length is recalled, not looked up
cars.prepared: a 6 mm voxel shell (scratch/sketchfab-cars/shells/m4-f82_shell_domino.stl, sha256 f526da39...) and carprep-record.json were written by another session on 2026-11-09; not reviewed here

cars.orientation: longest axis is glTF z, height is y
cars.scale_reading: 19.07 file units long: not metres. Roughly 4x a real car's length, so the unit or a scale node is unknown; the physical scale must be set from a measured feature (wheelbase) and recorded as an assumption

cars.orientation: longest axis is glTF z, height is y
cars.scale_reading: 4.39 x 1.86 x 1.11 file units. Against recalled dimensions of the real car (about 4.97 x 1.91 x 1.42 m) the length, width and height ratios differ (about 0.88, 0.97, 0.78), so a single scale factor cannot make it dimensionally faithful; the bounding box may also be cut by the wheels or missing parts. Treat its proportions as stylised

geometry_condition: All three are visual models: many open parts, interiors and decals, no closed assembly. Any aerodynamic use first needs an outer-shell extraction, closed wheels and a ground contact, recorded per car.
allowed_use_now: Labelled AI preview / domain-shift examples after these basic checks; outputs reported in model units with 'CFD validation pending'.
not_allowed: physical-scale claims without a recorded, measured scale basis
